# Protocol reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-reference.sh from crates/pando-proto/proto. Do not edit by hand. -->

Pando speaks gRPC (HTTP/2, and gRPC-Web for browsers). The `pando.v1` package is stable: it changes only by adding. Generate a client for any language from the files below; the [SDKs](../agents.md#sdks) wrap the read calls for Python, TypeScript and Go.

Calls to a server that hosts many repositories name one with the `x-pando-repo: OWNER/NAME` header. Every call takes a bearer token in `authorization` when the server requires one.

### Objects

Tier-agnostic object service. Served identically by server, cache and daemon.

|---|---|---|---|

| `Put` | `stream ObjectPayload` | `PutObjectsResponse` |  |
| `Missing` | `IdList` | `IdList` | Returns the subset of ids the tier cannot serve. |

### Browse

API-first file access: CI and tools read source without any checkout.

| Call | Request | Response | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ListDir` | `BrowseRequest` | `ListDirResponse` |  |
| `ReadFile` | `BrowseRequest` | `ReadFileResponse` |  |
| `Find` | `FindRequest` | `FindResponse` |  |
| `Checkout` | `CheckoutRequest` | `stream CheckoutPiece` | Path-scoped checkout: only files the caller may read. Used by principals with restricted read access, who may not read objects by id. |
